profile.headline: VP Full Stack Developer

positions.title: VP Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Decouple and componentize of Enterprise Integration Services. Migrated code repository from TFS to Bitbucket. Set up continuous integration including repository, unit test, compiling, packaging, quality test and deployment  to artifactory.

positions.title: Senior Associate/Full Stack Software Engineer - Projects Energy and Utilities
positions.description:
Architect, development and manage all Covanta SharePoint environments, including SP 2010 farm and SP online. Supports user base of 5500 corporate users. Develop workflow system to automate office business processes.
Own, enhance and maintain over most web apps supporting Covanta internal business functions.
Own, enhance and maintain most ETL processes including all .net etl modules and most SSIS modules.
Production support and manage offshore consultant for SiteCore system. 
Production support and vendor liaison for DVTDM document management system.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
•NET expertise in charge of development and administration of most of company’s (70%) .NET applications including web apps, .NET ETL processes and all SharePoint environments, in addition to other systems including DVTDM engineering document management system, PEGA and Workday integration.  
•Participate in all stages of SDLC. Conducted requirement collection, tool evaluation, system design and implementation, testing, deployment and production support. 
•Implemented the company's first .NET MVC web application that integrated back-end PEGA workflow system and delivered desktop and mobile front ends. 
•Developed .NET tools to extraction hundreds of thousand files from legacy HR document systems based on SharePoint 2007 and Knowledge Lake, together with their meta data. Developed .NET code to import these files to Workday system.
•Implemented company’s first SharePoint based workflow system using MS Flow. This process was received well by the businesses and saves tens of thousand dollars on software and consulting fee. It also significantly reduces the time for delivery cycle to a few weeks from several months.
•Maintained and upgraded the Operations Report system, a .NET web application used to manage the operations production data and system outages.
•Create and maintain company’s ETL processes that support inter system integration through databases, spreadsheets and text files.
•Overseeing the upgrade of Environmental Document Management System, first document management system implemented in the SharePoint online environment.
•Managing and supporting consulting firm to successfully upgrade the DVTDM document management system to newer version, including all server and client environments.      
•Implemented SharePoint management and migration strategies that include SP 2007 and 2010. The systems cover 5000 active users. Work involves content/meta data management, workflow, security design and implementation, health check and remediation, disaster recovery.

positions.title: Adjunct Professor
positions.description: Taught Introduction to Software and Programming to undergraduate students.

positions.title: Senior Software Consultant
positions.description:
Designed and implemented multitier Web application Credit Management System from scratch. This project implemented hundreds of Web forms, tables, stored-procedures and supports transactions, query, auditing and reporting using C#, ASP.NET Web Forms, SQL Server, Crystal Report and VSS.

Participated in build, migration, application integration and configuration.

positions.title: AVP
positions.description:
Developed and supported hedge fund applications, including index construction, NAV reporting, P/L, accounting, auditing, trade captures and transparency. Roles included design and development, requirement collection, client support and project management. (C#, ASP.NET, Win Forms, .NET, SQL Server, XML, Excel, FoxPro, Bloomberg, Crystal Report, SSRS)

Constructed hedge fund indexes based on inputs from hundreds of hedge funds. Implemented algorithms to calculate weighted returns. Created process for daily delivery to clients.

Developed net asset values (NAV) products based on complicated feeder structures.

Developed application to automate pricing database updating from Bloomberg.

Team LEAD of 3 developers for Fund of Fund System. Fixed existing bugs, enhanced functions. Facilitated auditing and reconciliation work under extreme time constraints. (.NET)

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Developed applications that facilitated information sharing, organizational administration, training and community collaboration. 

Application and database development, system support, user training and client supports.

Traveled to Europe, Asia, Africa and Latin America for client support and training.

volunteerExperiences.description: Coached a youth robotics team which captured the top Robotics Design Award in FLL Robotics Competition.
